name: OvisOCR2

lineage.how_derived: SFT, RL and OPD in multiple stages with a data engine of real and synthetic pages

purpose: Page-level document parsing: a page image to Markdown in reading order including formulas, tables and visual regions with bounding boxes.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: LICENSE file of the model repo is the unmodified Apache License 2.0 text; card agrees

architecture.kind: vision-language, Qwen3.5 0.8B (hybrid DeltaNet family) post-trained end to end
architecture.why_this_design: Compact end-to-end model; data filtering aims at repeated output, incomplete content, invalid table/formula structure and reading-order errors (card).

engine_support.notes: card lists 27 quantizations incl. GGUF-style; whether llama.cpp loads the Qwen3.5 vision tower for it is unchecked. A newer OvisOCR3 exists

benchmarks.name: OmniDocBench v1.6 overall (third-party pinned 1,651-page rerun)
benchmarks.harness: secondary summary of a third-party rerun, not verified

strengths: first end-to-end model on top of OmniDocBench v1.6 (vendor claim)
weaknesses: card warns about incorrect or incomplete output on real documents and asks for manual checks
best_for: page to Markdown for RAG pipelines

tona_fit.reason: strong vendor numbers at 0.9B and Apache-2.0 verified, but no independent or German result, a successor exists and its tower is Qwen3.5-based; keep until a German test exists

open_questions: llama.cpp support for this Qwen3.5-based vision tower

pc-16gb.notes: BF16 about 2 GB; Tona runs one model at a time, so it replaces the resident model while it works
